materiality.rationale: VideoGAIA is a multi-turn, tool-augmented video benchmark with 271 model-human co-designed tasks and three-expert verification per instance; it matters because it evaluates agentic video understanding with interaction and tools, not only static caption or QA accuracy.

profile_annotations.why_this_issue: This gives the Weekly issue a specific benchmark for assistants that must reason over video across turns and tools, making the evaluation scope clear before any model ranking is inferred.
